pages.title: Welcome, farmer
pages.text: Terres Vivantes runs a farm through the seasons. The soil wears out, the climate shifts, and animals have needs. This manual explains each system in the order you will meet them.

pages.title: The four seasons
pages.text: A year has four seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter. Each lasts 7 days by default (configurable). The HUD, at the top left, shows the current season and day.

pages.title: Climate and temperature
pages.text: Local temperature depends on biome, season, altitude and night. In winter, outdoor crops slow down a lot. A greenhouse shields them from the cold (+8 °C) and limits that slowdown.

pages.title: The almanac
pages.text: The almanac (a book and wheat) shows the season, the day, the local temperature and the crops to plant now: those whose season is optimal and whose temperature suits them. Right-click to open it.
